title: Automotive Experience Record MVP v0.4.0
description: A minimal, evidence-grounded automotive experience record with required journey stage and record-level extraction confidence.

experience_id.description: Unique record ID generated by the pipeline.

experience_type.description: Whether the experience is reported as lived, anticipated, hypothetical, second-hand, or a general opinion.

user_id.description: Existing User entity ID, only when confidently resolved; otherwise omit or use null.

product_id.description: Existing Product/VehicleVersion entity ID, only when confidently resolved; otherwise omit or use null.

label.description: Normalized attribute label. Add new labels only through taxonomy versioning.

raw_term.description: The term used in the original text, e.g. '续航' or '车机'.

description.description: A concise, neutral summary of what was experienced, expected, or claimed. Do not add causes or facts not present in the source.

scenario.description: Short scenario phrase grounded in text, e.g. '冬季高速'. Omit if not stated or inferable with high confidence.

context.description: Optional concrete usage situation, e.g. winter highway driving. Customer journey stage is stored in the required top-level journey_stage field.

sentiment.description: Categorical sentiment label. Omit the entire evaluation object when no evaluation/sentiment is expressed; use unclear only when an evaluative expression exists but its polarity cannot be determined.

sentiment_score.description: Numeric sentiment score in [-1, 1]: -1 = strongly negative, 0 = neutral or balanced net polarity, +1 = strongly positive. Null only when sentiment is unclear. This is a model estimate, not an objective measurement.

text.description: Short original evaluation phrase, e.g. '太差了'. Omit if no short explicit phrase is available.

event_time.description: Time when the experience occurred, only if stated clearly; do not substitute post publication time.

source_id.description: ID of the source post/comment in the evidence store.

quote.description: Exact source excerpt supporting this record.

journey_stage.description: Required stage label. Use unknown when the text is insufficient to classify; use general_discussion when the text clearly expresses a general opinion or discussion not tied to a specific journey stage.

extraction_confidence.description: Model-estimated confidence in the correctness of the structured extraction, not the probability that the reported experience is objectively true. Use for prioritizing review; calibrate against human annotations before treating as probabilistic.
